title: Don Toliver, Future, Leon Thomas & Steve Lacy to Perform at Tyler, The Creator’s Camp Flog Gnaw 2026
summary: The 12th installment of the festival is taking over Dodger Stadium on in November.
contentText:
Tyler, The Creator revealed the lineup for Camp Flog Gnaw 2026 on Tuesday (Aug. 18), but fans had to work to unscramble the artists on the festival’s website.

In addition to a headlining set from Tyler, fans can expect performances from Don Toliver, Future, Syd, Steve Lacy, Leon Thomas, 310babii, 2hollis, JID, Isaiah Rashad, Earl Sweatshirt & MIKE, Lola Young, Lupe Fiasco, Vince Staples, Turnstile, Natanya, Domo Genesis, The Alchemist, Gabriel Jacoby and Ama.

In collaboration with Golden Voice, Camp Flog Gnaw returns for its 12th installment, with the festival set to take over Dodger Stadium once again on Nov. 14-15. Tickets are sold out, but waitlisting options are currently open in case more tickets become available.

Tyler’s been pretty quiet on the music front for 2026. He’s released a pair of singles on streaming services, which previously lived on his YouTube account, including “Sag Harbor” and “That Guy,” the latter of which finds him rapping over Kendrick Lamar’s GNX cut “Hey Now.”

Much of the rest of the lineup has been busy this year. Don Toliver kicked off 2026 by notching his first No. 1 album atop the Billboard 200 with Octane , which arrived in January. Future returned in July with his album The Real Me , earning him his 12th No. 1 album on the Billboard 200 .

2025’s festival was postponed a week due to inclement weather around Los Angeles. Last year’s Camp Flog Gnaw featured performances from Kali Uchis, Doechii, A$AP Rocky, Childish Gambino and 2 Chainz.

Tyler, The Creator’s last album arrived in July 2025 with  Don’t Tap the Glass , which reached No. 1 on the  Billboard 200  with 197,000 total album-equivalent units earned, according to Luminate.
